name: Darroch Ball
status_detail: Chief of staff to NZ First leader Winston Peters since the 2023 election (also his 2023 campaign manager). Interim NZ First president Dec 2020 – Jun 2021; former Sensible Sentencing Trust leader. Not a 2026 candidate.
roles: Chief of staff to Winston Peters (2023–)
Co-leader then leader, Sensible Sentencing Trust (2021–2022)
